summary: Comprehensive audit trail exists across the codebase. The CQC pipeline creates immutable snapshots with checksums. /api/v1/version returns the deployed Git SHA for exact release identification. The quality audit (quality_report.json) records per-field completeness. The validation report (validation_report.json) tracks 65,019 records with issue categorization. The deployment checklist (DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) documents release gates. The production audit (PRODUCTION_AUDIT.md) provides historical audit evidence. The prod-ready branches contain evidence of: stripe-key-rotation, webhook-secret-encryption, migration-downgrades, soft-delete-dsar, two-gate-claim-verification. Sentry integration provides error telemetry.
assertions: Immutable CQC snapshots with checksums for data lineage
Quality and validation reports with per-record tracking
Deployment checklist with explicit release gates
Prod-ready branches for key rotation, webhook encryption, DSAR, migration downgrades
